{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Sensorpod.jpg|150px|thumb]]
A '''sensor pod''' was a piece of equipment that [[dustdiver]]s working for the [[Sungrazer cooperative]] attached to their [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suits]]. They were supposed to be a safety measure for the miners but in reality were used by the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] overseers to track the divers. They could be used to deliver an electric shock through the miner's enviro-suit if they were off schedule or got out of line.
